answers_to_20_questions.q2_is_database_driven: YES. Synced and loaded from PostgreSQL branch records with runtime caching in ApiEngine store
answers_to_20_questions.q3_which_timezone: 'Asia/Kolkata' (IST, UTC+5:30) configured via global_config.business_timezone with fallback
answers_to_20_questions.q4_is_utc_converted: YES. UTC timestamps are converted to local IST using getNowInTimezone('Asia/Kolkata') and Intl.DateTimeFormat
answers_to_20_questions.q5_independent_timing: YES. Each branch has its own isolated 'weekly_schedule' dictionary and operational windows in branch.metadata
answers_to_20_questions.q6_does_changing_a_affect_b: NO. Mutating weekly_schedule or availability for Branch A only modifies branch A's metadata row
answers_to_20_questions.q7_frontend_vs_backend_calculation: Backend (/api/v1/fulfillment/delivery-slots) is authoritative. Frontend components invoke the backend endpoint
answers_to_20_questions.q8_can_client_bypass_timing: NO. Server-side validateDeliverySlot/ApiEngine re-validates cutoff, date, and availability on checkout mutation
answers_to_20_questions.q9_are_cutoffs_enforced_server_side: YES. ApiEngine.getDeliverySlots filters out windows whose cutoff time (order_cutoff_mins) has elapsed
answers_to_20_questions.q10_are_slots_validated_on_checkout: YES. Order submission re-validates delivery_slot against current branch operational state
answers_to_20_questions.q11_what_happens_around_midnight: Date string rolls over to the next day in IST (+05:30) using getNowInTimezone, switching daily schedule cleanly
answers_to_20_questions.q12_dst_handling: IST (Asia/Kolkata) has no Daylight Saving Time (fixed UTC+5:30 offset), preventing DST shift regressions
answers_to_20_questions.q13_closed_days: Day schedules with is_open: false return status 'CLOSED_ON_DAY' with empty delivery_slots array
answers_to_20_questions.q14_temporarily_disabled: temporary_closure.is_paused sets status 'PAUSED' and returns pauseMessage until pause_until timestamp
answers_to_20_questions.q15_manager_turns_cake_off: Availability is toggled in branch.metadata.product_availability; subsequent cart checkout rejects disabled cake
answers_to_20_questions.q16_can_stale_cart_order_unavailable: NO. Checkout pipeline validates every line item against branch availability at order creation time
answers_to_20_questions.q17_can_customer_select_unsupported_slot: NO. Slots are filtered by branch delivery zone and delivery mode (pickup vs delivery)
answers_to_20_questions.q18_can_customer_order_after_cutoff: NO. Server rejects orders placed after the designated slot cutoff
answers_to_20_questions.q19_can_customer_select_past_date: NO. Delivery slots API and checkout validator reject dates prior to current date in IST
answers_to_20_questions.q20_accidental_config_reuse: NO. Branch metadata is keyed by unique branch ID in PostgreSQL and isolated in queries
